items.title: Harry "Chicken" Oscar Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: So they sent old man Joe Martinez there to break up the band... And when we passed World Lines coming back, we had 57 men that came down Canal Street... we played everything from Stars and Stripes Forever down to Gloria.

ctx.x: Was Carnish in there? Do you remember? No, no. Bill Carnish never did get in the band.

Or Sonny Henry? Sonny Henry came in after the band had been organized. Oh, maybe three months. But as the band progressed, they had 167 men in the band. Some could read and some couldn't read. So they said they was going to find out who could read and who couldn't read. So they sent old man Joe Martinez there to break up the band. That's what he was sent there for to break up the band. So when he came, he found so many fellas could read music. He scratched his head. He said, I've got something here I can do…
